question: What attainments make a practitioner beloved by the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute supreme accomplishment.
Such accomplishment brings favor from yoginīs.
A practitioner may attain this beloved status.
inference: One who attains enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
